The '''1987–88 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 57th since its establishment. It began on 29 August 1987, and concluded on 22 May 1988.

[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] finished the season as champions for the third season running, the runners-up this time being [[Real Sociedad]], while [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] finished a disappointing sixth, though they did at least have [[1987–88 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]] success as consolation for their lack of form in the league.

== Teams and location ==
This season, the league was expanded to 20 teams and the [[La Liga playoffs|relegation playoffs]] returned.
